sentences.text: Shailene Diann Woodley -LRB- born November 15 , 1991 -RRB- is an American actress .

Born in San Bernardino County , California and raised in the Simi Valley , she took acting classes with Anthony Meindl and made her screen debut in the television film Replacing Dad -LRB- 1999 -RRB- , followed by numerous guest roles on television , including as Kaitlin Cooper on The O.C. -LRB- 2003-04 -RRB- , and several television films .
